summary: YouTube Ad Punisher is a browser extension that automatically reloads a YouTube page when an advertisement is detected, aiming to improve uninterrupted viewing. It is built as a Chrome and Firefox add‑on written in JavaScript and distributed via the GitHub repo without a package‑manager install. The tool is suited for users frustrated by YouTube ads who want a simple, install‑once solution. Its standout strength is the unique auto‑reload behavior, while the limited test coverage (1 of 4 tests passed) reveals stability concerns.
